title: 3C-SiC: polar electron-phonon coupling (Froehlich, quadrupoles) and mobility
summary: Electron-phonon system folder of cubic SiC, the polar case: the long-range dipole (Froehlich) and quadrupole model subtracted and restored around the PAO interpolation, the phonons with the LO-TO splitting, the 1/|q| coupling of the LO mode, the dynamical quadrupoles from single-q ph.x runs and the electron and hole mobilities.

steps.label: Quantum ESPRESSO: scf, ph.x, nscf
steps.note: qe/phonon: scf and ph.x on the 6^3 q-grid with epsil (eps_inf, Z*) and fildvscf; qe/nscf: the 6^3 nscf on the irreducible wedge, started from a copy of the scf charge density (run_qe.sh does it); NP ranks, 8 by default

steps.label: Phonon dispersion (LO-TO)
steps.note: q2r + matdyn in PAOFLOW with the dipole term -> phonons/output

steps.label: Long-range check
steps.note: |g_LO(Gamma, q)| along Gamma-X with and without the dipole model

steps.label: Carrier mobility
steps.note: 36^3 k = q, SERTA/MRTA with the polar coupling (5 min on 8 ranks)

steps.label: Quadrupoles: ph.x inputs
steps.note: twelve single-q ph.x inputs and run.sh under qe/phonon/quadrupoles

steps.label: Quadrupoles: ph.x runs
steps.note: ph.x with fildrho on each q (needs the scf wavefunctions of qe/phonon)

steps.label: Carrier mobility with the quadrupoles
steps.note: the path of --quadrupoles is relative to the system folder; the converged values of README.md use --nk 60 --nq 60
